svg.title: LiDAR-Based Ego Lane Detection illustration
svg.desc: Bird's-eye view of a LiDAR point cloud: high-intensity lane-marking points, sliding-window boxes tracking each lane, and polynomial curves fitted to the left and right lane of the ego vehicle.
